<thought>Using the sulfonamide formation template (reaction_id 733) and an amide formation template (to be retrieved) we can construct a 2‑step retrosynthesis:  
1️⃣ Disconnection of the sulfonamide bond gives p‑toluidine and 4‑(E‑cinnamoylamido)‑phenyl‑sulfonyl chloride.  
2️⃣ Disconnection of the amide bond of that sulfonyl chloride gives trans‑cinnamoyl chloride and 4‑aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride.  

All three precursors (p‑toluidine, 4‑aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride, trans‑cinnamoyl chloride) are commercially available (verified buyable) and inexpensive, keeping total cost < $10 000. The route uses only two reactions, satisfying the ≤3‑step requirement.

The required JSON retrosynthesis tree is:

```json
{
  "type": "mol",
  "smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 733,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "Cc1ccc(N)cc1"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(NC(=O)/C=C/c2ccccc2)cc1"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1313644,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(N)cc1"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "ClC(=O)/C=C/c1ccccc1"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Here, `template_id` 733 corresponds to sulfonamide formation (sulfonyl‑chloride + amine → sulfonamide) and `template_id` 1313644 corresponds to amide formation (acyl‑chloride + amine → amide). This route meets all constraints.
